name: Guangdong Naruida Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Naruida Technology Co., Ltd. provides full polarization active phased array radar system solutions in China. The company offers AXPT0464-A, a type X-band dual-polarization one-dimensional active phased array radar; WDSPT0152 radar, an S-band fully polarized active phased array meteorological radar product; WDCPT0152, a C-band fully polarized active phased array weather radar; AXPT0464, a fixed, multi-functional dual-polarization active phased array radar capable of detecting weather and targets; and HAXPT0164, a X-band dual-polarized phased array rainfall radar is a new type of equipment that provides real-time or near-real-time rainfall detection information for water conservancy …
